races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
MISS MONA KEEBA shaped very well when second of 21 over C&D on debut a fortnight ago, travelling best before perhaps going on too soon, and with improvement expected she is fancied to go one better. Tequila Belle is feared most after finishing a couple of places behind her that day and Villaray also respected despite the trip possibly being on the sharp side.

  1. MISS MONA KEEBA (IRE)
  2. TEQUILA BELLE (IRE)
  3. VILLARAY (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Parties At Navan Racecourse 5th & 13th December Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
CARRIGANS GROVE has hinted at a revival on her last 2 starts and is taken to capitalise on a reduced mark with cheekpieces back on. Rodeeve is feared most if backing up her C&D third last time ahead of El Fontenaro. Well-treated course specialist Step Back In Time and Alnofoor completing the shortlist.

  1. CARRIGANS GROVE (IRE)
  2. RODEEVE
  3. EL FONTENARO (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
Having bumped into subsequent Queen Mary winner Victorious when last seen at Naas in the spring, AEDHMAR gets the confident vote to go one better with further improvement on the cards. Eyeconic showed more than on debut at Cork early last month, so she may be the one to provide most resistance having been out of her depth last time. Senuna and New World Order round off the shortlist.

  1. AEDHMAR (IRE)
  2. EYECONIC (IRE)
  3. SENUNA (IRE)

races.name: Navan Racing Festival Advanced Price Tickets On Sale Now Maiden
races.verdict:
GRANDE CUVEE produced a below-par effort on handicap debut last time, but she had been progressing well prior to that and is taken to bounce back as she returns to maiden company. She gets the vote ahead of Osterode, who has finished runner-up on her last 2 starts, with My Cubby Bear also considered.

  1. GRANDE CUVEE (IRE)
  2. OSTERODE (IRE)
  3. MY CUBBY BEAR (IRE)

races.name: Final Fence Marquee Hospitality Package 14th & 15th November On Sale Now Handicap
races.verdict:
BAD BOY RIZZ boasts proven C&D form from last October and can bounce back from recent disappointments now blinkers are removed and he's returned to this shorter trip. Bay of Supremacy wasn't disgraced in significantly stronger company at Naas and drops in grade, whilst Gerrit's Gem returned to form with an encouraging second at Naas and is also respected. Gazelle D'or is also worth a second look.

  1. BAD BOY RIZZ (IRE)
  2. BAY OF SUPREMACY (IRE)
  3. GERRIT'S GEM (IRE)

races.name: Kilberry Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
This looks a decent opportunity for the consistent NAUTIC STAR to gain a deserved first success. Elmakaya and Vishaya were both below-par last time but would pose the biggest threats if able to bounce back to their bests.

  1. NAUTIC STAR (IRE)
  2. ELMAKAYA (IRE)
  3. VISHAYA (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Towers Watson Maiden
races.verdict:
A reproduction of the form POSSUM showed in a handicap at Listowel last month could be good enough. Dual bumper scorer Teofil can win on the Flat too based on his runner-up effort at Thurles recently. The selection's 3-time hurdle winning stablemate Quinta Do Lago is next on the list.

  1. POSSUM (IRE)
  2. TEOFIL (IRE)
  3. QUINTA DO LAGO (FR)

races.name: Navan Racecourse Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
GOODIE GIRL looks on a good mark based on her hurdle ability and may prove the answer to this open finale. Maxwell Smart came clear at Bellewstown last time and a 5 lb rise shouldn't prevent another prominent showing if in similar form. Noel Meade pair Acanto and Chestnut Palace have fewer miles on the clock than most of these and also make the shortlist.

  1. GOODIE GIRL (IRE)
  2. MAXWELL SMART (IRE)
  3. ACANTO (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Back Again At Newmarket Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GRINANBEARIT's debut form has been boosted so she's very much the call before any betting clues are known about the newcomers. Cinematically and Ryan Moore's mount Scarlett's Spell look the most interesting of those debutantes before any market pointers can be taken into consideration.

  1. GRINANBEARIT (IRE)
  2. CINEMATICALLY (IRE)
  3. SCARLETT'S SPELL (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet For Champions League Profit Boosts Novice Stakes
races.verdict:
ALTIUS sets the bar high on his latest C&D second and should prove hard to beat. El Waabil made a pleasing start to his career at Redcar last month and can fill the forecast spot unless the betting vibes are strong surrounding Ralph Beckett newcomer Enactment.

  1. ALTIUS
  2. EL WAABIL
  3. ENACTMENT (USA)

races.name: CopyBet Proudly Backs UK Horse Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Charlie Appleby has won 4 of the last 5 runnings of this, including twice with newcomers, so his debutant FUTURE ROLE gets the nod, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Night of Gold and Henrik Ibsen can follow him home in that order.

  1. FUTURE ROLE
  2. NIGHT OF GOLD
  3. HENRIK IBSEN (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Future Stayers Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
LOTS ROAD had plenty to spare on his Goodwood nursery debut and should take plenty of stopping under a penalty. Girl Scout impressed when winning twice over 1m at Haydock last month and can give Ralph Beckett's charge most to do ahead of Noble Prince.

  1. LOTS ROAD (IRE)
  2. GIRL SCOUT
  3. NOBLE PRINCE

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
LUNA CELESTE was progressing well when last seen early in September and she's fancied to resume winning ways for stable having an excellent time of things at the moment. Proposal looks sure to be suited by the return to 1m so is a major threat, while Previous needs checking in the betting after nearly a year off.

  1. LUNA CELESTE (IRE)
  2. PROPOSAL
  3. PREVIOUS

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Future Stayers Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
MUQARRABIN really got the hang of things late on when making a successful debut at Kempton 3 weeks ago and with improvement on the cards, he gets the vote to remain unbeaten. The market will no doubt prove informative with the rest all being debutants, stablemate Al Lahbab edging the vote for the forecast spot over Mawrid.

  1. MUQARRABIN
  2. AL LAHBAB
  3. MAWRID

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Nursery
races.verdict:
WASHINGTON ROYALE quickly got back on track when third in a nursery at Nottingham last time and, with a return to softer ground promising to suit, he is taken to double his tally. Heading the list of dangers is Rex Regum, who arrives on the back of a clear-cut success at Pontefract, while Crowned is also respected in his hat-trick bid.

  1. WASHINGTON ROYALE
  2. REX REGUM
  3. CROWNED (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Good to soft-good in places on hurdle course

races.name: Betting.Bet Free Racing Tips Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TREAD CAREFULLY went 0-6 over hurdles last season but the form he showed in defeat on several occasions means he sets the standard. The form of On The Bayou's Exeter second means he remains of interest, whilst the pick of several intriguing hurdling debutants is perhaps Fergal O'Brien's Cool Customer.

  1. TREAD CAREFULLY (IRE)
  2. ON THE BAYOU (IRE)
  3. COOL CUSTOMER (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet New Betting Sites Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
KNOWN WARRIOR shaped as if still ahead of his mark on several occasions last season and is taken to get off the mark. Chatty Girl appeals as one who should do better over fences and can pose the biggest threat on her first start in this sphere.

  1. KNOWN WARRIOR (FR)
  2. CHATTY GIRL (IRE)
  3. EVERYONESACRITIC (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet Play Champion Tipster Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
This looks trappy but a breathing operation may help EASTERN SHORES finish off her race with a bit more purpose and with her stable among the winners, she's worth chancing. Inion Tiogair was in top form in the spring and is the obvious alternative.

  1. EASTERN SHORES
  2. INION TIOGAIR (IRE)
  3. DIAMOND WHITE (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GRAND CONQUEROR has a progressive profile and, having run well in a race that's proving strong form at Fakenham when last seen, is of major interest on his return to action from a 1 lb higher mark. Just A Glance and Motazzen head the opposition.

  1. GRAND CONQUEROR (IRE)
  2. JUST A GLANCE
  3. MOTAZZEN (IRE)

races.name: tigerbet.co.uk Download Our App Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
DARING PLAN escapes a penalty for his recent win at Newton Abbot and is the percentage call to complete the hat-trick under a rider who continues to look good value for his claim. Carrigmoorna Rowan and chasing debutant Walkinthepresent are feared most.

  1. DARING PLAN (IRE)
  2. CARRIGMOORNA ROWAN (IRE)
  3. WALKINTHEPRESENT (IRE)

races.name: tigerbet.co.uk Extra Place Races Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
I LOVE YOU SIVOLA revived on first outing for Max Comley when scoring at Hereford last week and should cope with the return to a shorter trip, so he's taken to follow up under a 7-lb penalty. County Champs is a little unlucky to still be a long-standing maiden and he's second choice, ahead of lightly-raced 5-y-o Sailing By, who could potentially raise his game now moving up in distance.

  1. I LOVE YOU SIVOLA (FR)
  2. COUNTY CHAMPS (IRE)
  3. SAILING BY (IRE)

races.name: Fred & Mercy Rimell Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a strong race for the level with ALBIE LITTLEWOOD taken to pick up where he left off in the winter on chase debut for his leading stable. Kool Kid has experience over the larger obstacles and was also thriving when last seen, with Jamada another sure to be well prepared for this.

  1. ALBIE LITTLEWOOD (IRE)
  2. KOOL KID
  3. JAMADA (IRE)

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KLIMT MADRIK was runner-up in last season’s Challow Hurdle at Newbury and not only does he set the standard on hurdles form, he has long appealed as the type to make an even better chaser. He gets the vote, with 4-time hurdles winner Scorpio Rising another good chasing prospect despite his Grade 1 flop and Talk To The Man also likely to do better this season.

  1. KLIMT MADRIK (FR)
  2. SCORPIO RISING (IRE)
  3. TALK TO THE MAN (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet For Champions League Profit Boosts NH Flat Race (Conditional & Amateur Jockeys) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A fascinating bumper in which several leading yards are represented. The vote goes to BALLYDINE BOY, a point winner who made the frame in a Clonmel bumper that has worked out well and has since been recruited by the Olly Murphy yard. His stablemate Maxi Twist and Dan Skelton's Dressforsuccess are next on the shortlist on their Rules debut.

  1. BALLYDINE BOY (IRE)
  2. DRESSFORSUCCESS (IRE)
  3. MAXI TWIST (IRE)

races.name: Richard And Ann Hitchings Memorial Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BOOMBOX made an encouraging start under Rules when beaten only by the odds-on favourite in a Killarney bumper in May, so she appeals as one to note on her hurdling/stable debut. She gets the vote ahead of Frost Moon, who commands respect as she goes over hurdles for the Skeltons, while Our Peggy can also make her presence felt.

  1. BOOMBOX (IRE)
  2. FROST MOON (IRE)
  3. OUR PEGGY (IRE)

races.name: Richard And Ann Hitchings Memorial Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
The market will no doubt prove informative in this mares' novice with the majority making their hurdling debut. Preference is for LUNE BRILLANTE, who is the pick of these on bumper form and Harry Skelton has chosen her over Wet Sail. Second choice is Sapphos Word, who twice found only one too strong in bumpers last season, with Jenny France taken to fill out third.

  1. LUNE BRILLANTE (IRE)
  2. SAPPHOS WORD (IRE)
  3. JENNY FRANCE (IRE)

races.name: Squarcle Sprint Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MISTER DES PLACES has a fair mark to exploit on his British debut and having joined a leading stable, further improvement may well be forthcoming. He shades the vote in favour of Leaumec de Mee and Limier D'arthel.

  1. MISTER DES PLACES (FR)
  2. LEAUMEC DE MEE (FR)
  3. LIMIER D'ARTHEL (FR)

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DELTA BLUES BELLE had a ready excuse on her final start last season and is taken to resume her progression on her return. Pounds At The Time shaped well in his first handicap at the end of last year and could pose a threat if ready to roll on his first run since. Roe And Co is next on the list after his good third here a fortnight ago.

  1. DELTA BLUES BELLE (IRE)
  2. POUNDS AT THE TIME (IRE)
  3. ROE AND CO (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MARIOLE came good in a maiden at Chepstow when last seen in the spring and gets the nod to follow up on his handicap debut. Square du Roule also ended last season in fine form and is second choice ahead of Nicky Martin handicap newcomer Docteur Romeo.

  1. MARIOLE (FR)
  2. SQUARE DU ROULE (FR)
  3. DOCTEUR ROMEO (FR)

races.name: Unibet Interactive 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The well-related WOOTTON KING produced a very promising first effort when second in a C&D maiden 3 weeks ago, showing greenness before doing his best work at the finish. In leading hands and rating a sure-fire improver, he can go one place better here. Andrew Balding saddles a pair of interesting newcomers in the shape of Chariots of Fire and Bayside Waltz and the betting can likely decipher their chances.

  1. WOOTTON KING
  2. CHARIOTS OF FIRE (IRE)
  3. BAYSIDE WALTZ (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's Superboosts/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DADDY STAR showed plenty of ability when finishing runner up on debut in a Yarmouth maiden (7f) 5 weeks ago, making her effort on the opposite flank to the winner and finishing nicely clear of the rest. She's the type to build on that effort and holds sound claims from a handy draw. Out Late may emerge as the lead danger, with Stilton a newcomer to note from the Hugo Palmer stable.

  1. DADDY STAR (IRE)
  2. OUT LATE (IRE)
  3. STILTON

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The well-related LADY'S GRACE proved too green to justify her strength in the betting when fourth on debut at Southwell 2 weeks ago but that experience ought not to have been wasted on her and she's fancied to build on that and go close from her handy inside draw. Wannabe Perfect and Weatheringwithyou are 2 likely looking newcomers from very good yards and command a check in the betting for clues, with Zephyra another entitled to be thereabouts.

  1. LADY'S GRACE
  2. WANNABE PERFECT
  3. WEATHERINGWITHYOU

races.name: Try Unibet's Improved Acca Boosts Nursery
races.verdict:
A competitive nursery with the narrow vote in favour of GREAT OAK. A winner of a match race on debut at Ayr, he had viable excuses for a below-par showing at Haydock next time and he surely remains capable of better now handicapping from what looks a workable opening mark. Horndean on his first crack at 7f, Babzini and Somers Isles are others to consider, along with Tansy Lane.

  1. GREAT OAK (IRE)
  2. HORNDEAN (FR)
  3. BABZINI (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BOATSWAIN hasn't been disgraced on each of his last 2 starts on turf but there remains a definite case for believing he's better on all-weather than turf (2-3 on all-weather) and he could be worth siding with from an easing mark in an open-looking heat. Real Dream from his reduced mark, Ascot scorer Hot Fuss and the returning Codiak are others to consider.

  1. BOATSWAIN
  2. REAL DREAM (IRE)
  3. HOT FUSS (IRE)

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict:
BUCCABAY is well treated on last winter's C&D success and his latest effort was too bad to be true so, with the assistance of Billy Loughnane in the saddle now, he could well bounce back with a win. Both Caragio and Modern Times have shown recent form that makes them of plenty of interest for shrewd yards and could the biggest threats.

  1. BUCCABAY (IRE)
  2. CARAGIO (IRE)
  3. MODERN TIMES

races.name: Try Unibet's Improved Acca Boosts Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
NZURI was totally unfancied in the betting when winning twice recently but there was no fluke about it having been up with a solid pace throughout each time and she's taken to bring up the hat-trick at the expense of Happier who may find stall 10 a stumbling block. Lady Mariko and Magna are ones to keep an eye on from attractive marks.

  1. NZURI
  2. HAPPIER (IRE)
  3. LADY MARIKO

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict:
RIDGER has looked a different beast in recent weeks so Ollie Sangster's progressive 3-y-o is selected to complete the hat-trick at the expense of Iconic Times, who also arrives on a hat-trick but has been off 11 weeks since scrambling home at Catterick. Dark Mandate and Viking Glory are another couple worthy of consideration, too.

  1. RIDGER (IRE)
  2. ICONIC TIMES
  3. DARK MANDATE
